name: studio-additions-pl
description: Integration of the knowledge added in 1.91 to 1.93 (recommended repositories, AI writing patterns, craft rules and lint, contrast, DESIGN.md, prompt examples, lyric timing, Iso Glow, art-style direction, reference breakdown), upscaling (1.95.0) and the owners added by the 2026-10-19 audit (page mockups, decks, contrast). reads_any and skills_any check that the host reached the right file or owner; the rubric feeds the advisory judge. Status: not_run (owner decision 2026-10-19: no host tests for now).

cases.title: Welcome option 4 lists the recommended repositories with how they install

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:workflow-orchestrator 4

rubric: Lists the recommended repositories with a one-line description each
Says how each installs on this host or that it is manual or not supported
Installs nothing without an explicit request

cases.title: Copy that reads as AI goes through the AI writing patterns

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Ten tekst brzmi jak z AI, popraw go: „W dzisiejszym dynamicznym świecie nasza innowacyjna platforma to nie tylko narzędzie, to rewolucja. Dowiedz się więcej!”

rubric: Names the patterns found (empty vocabulary, negative parallelism, generic CTA)
Keeps the facts and does not invent new claims
Does not remove dashes only because they are dashes

cases.title: A landing page mockup goes to the static owner with the craft rules

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób mi makietę landingu w HTML dla pracowni ceramiki „Glina”: hero, oferta warsztatów, kontakt.

rubric: Uses the craft rules (no default indigo, no emoji icons, real hierarchy, honest placeholders)
Runs or offers craft_lint on the HTML where code runs
Does not invent testimonials or metrics

cases.title: A contrast question is measured, not guessed

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Czy biały tekst na kolorze #F2A541 będzie czytelny na plakacie?

rubric: Gives the contrast ratio and the WCAG threshold it is judged against
Suggests a fix when it fails

cases.title: A pitch deck design has an owner

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zaprojektuj wygląd 10-slajdowego pitch decku dla startupu z dostawą warzyw.

rubric: Treats the deck design as static design and the words as Copy Voice
Applies the craft rules to the slides

cases.title: A brand kit for a coding agent becomes DESIGN.md

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Mam kolory i fonty marki, programista robi stronę w Claude Code. Przygotuj mu plik DESIGN.md.

rubric: Exports the supplied kit, no invented values
Says which values are missing

cases.title: A beat-synced lyric video goes to Motion Graphics with lyric timing

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Mam piosenkę i tekst, chcę lyric video z animowaną typografią w rytm muzyki.

rubric: Takes the lyrics as the truth and times them from the audio
Asks for the track and rights confirmation; commits no audio

cases.title: A speaker that pumps with the bass uses Iso Glow

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób izometryczną animację głośnika, który świeci i pulsuje w rytm basu mojego utworu.

rubric: Uses the Iso Glow kit and drives it with audio_envelope
Only live parts glow; one accent colour

cases.title: A painter-style explainer uses the art-style direction

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Chcę 30-sekundową animację o historii kawy w stylu żywego obrazu impresjonistów.

rubric: Follows the art-style direction rules for camera and look
Does not imitate a living artist by name

cases.title: A reference animation is measured before rebuilding

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Wysyłam link do animacji, którą lubię. Rozbierz ją na części i zrób coś w podobnej technice dla mojej marki.

rubric: Measures cuts, timing and motion before writing code
Rebuilds the mechanism on new material, never copies frames

cases.title: Prompt examples are used before a web search for prompt technique

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Napisz prompt do zdjęcia produktowego butelki oliwy na marmurze, w świetle porannym.

rubric: May use reviewed prompt examples for structure; the direction is its own
Gives one standalone prompt

cases.title: An image too small for print is measured and upscaled with a commercial-safe model

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Mam wygenerowaną grafikę 1024×1536 i chcę ją wydrukować jako plakat A3 dla klienta. Jak ją powiększyć?

rubric: Measures the effective resolution at A3 and states the gap
Prefers a better source before upscaling
Names a model licensed for paid work and warns about non-commercial models
Sets text after enlarging, not before

cases.title: A dense brand showreel takes colours from the brand and checks scene logic

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób mi 15-sekundową dynamiczną rolkę showreel dla mojej stolarni, w stylu tych szybkich reelsów agencyjnych z czatem na początku. Logo w załączniku.

rubric: Takes the palette and objects from the brand logo, not from a reference look
Plans a carrier from the logo and one action per board
Each tool works on its material from a readable side and transitions come out of the actions
Gives chat messages reading time

cases.title: A finished reel gets its sound checked against the cuts with numbers

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Mam gotową rolkę MP4 z dźwiękiem. Sprawdź, czy efekty wchodzą równo na cięcia i czy głośność jest dobra.

rubric: Measures loudness, true peak and the hits against the cuts with the listening tools instead of guessing
Reports which cuts have no sound and the offset of late hits in milliseconds
Names what the numbers cannot judge (taste, genre fit)
Does not claim to have heard the sound and does not upload the audio anywhere

cases.title: Workflow startup style: a later bare invocation gets one ready line, not the welcome

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio chcę styl startu workflow: bez menu powitalnego, podpinaj się po cichu.
@FrameCore Works Creative Studio

cases.title: Workflow startup style: an explicit menu request still gets the complete welcome

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio chcę styl startu workflow: bez menu powitalnego, podpinaj się po cichu.
@FrameCore Works Creative Studio menu

cases.title: Captions for a Reels ad use the dated Meta safe zone in pixels

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Robię reklamę na Instagram Reels 1080x1920 z wypalonymi napisami. Gdzie dokładnie mogę umieścić napisy, żeby nic ich nie zasłoniło?

rubric: Gives Meta's 14 % top, 35 % bottom and 6 % side zone with pixels for 1080x1920
Says the platform preview must be checked and that automatic captions should be turned off
Does not invent numbers for TikTok or YouTube

cases.title: A Polish gifted-product UGC ad gets two disclosures in Polish

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Influencerka dostała od nas krem za darmo i nagra rolkę na Instagram i TikTok. Jak ma to oznaczyć, żeby było zgodnie z zasadami w Polsce?

rubric: Requires both an in-content label in Polish at the start and the platform label (Paid partnership, TikTok toggle)
Treats the free product as a benefit that needs disclosure, with the UOKiK first-gift nuance
Names terms that are not enough (#ad, #współpraca) and says it is not legal advice

cases.title: An English client gets the English handoff letter with jurisdiction-neutral rights

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio I've finished a poster and social posts for a client in Germany. Write me the handoff email with the files and the rights we agreed (non-exclusive licence for online use, 2 years).

rubric: Writes the letter in English from the English template, not a translation of the Polish one
States the licence as agreed and tells the user to check the legal terms for Germany
Includes files by use, an acceptance request and nothing the offer did not include

cases.title: Positioning starts from questions and an evidence ledger, not invented facts

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Pomóż mi ustalić pozycjonowanie dla mojej szkoły tańca dla dorosłych początkujących w Krakowie. Nie mam jeszcze żadnych badań.

rubric: Works through the method's questions and asks at most one or two material questions
Keeps an evidence ledger or marks claims as user-stated, inferred or unknown
Does not invent competitors, prices or statistics for Krakow

cases.title: A multi-stage video gets a backwards schedule, a budget with the user's rates and gates

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Mam 3 tygodnie na kampanię wideo: spot 30 s i 4 wersje pionowe na social. Rozpisz mi harmonogram, budżet i akceptacje.

rubric: Plans backwards from the delivery date with a critical path and review dates
Leaves rates blank or asks for the user's rates instead of inventing prices
Names approval gates and what each locks, plus change control
